title: Formally smooth local maps of complete Noetherian local rings are regular
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m_A)$ and $(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local rings which are complete, i.e. $\mathfrak m_A$-adically, resp. $\mathfrak m_B$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_A)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$). If $B$ is formally smooth over $A$ for the $\mathfrak m_B$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], then $\varphi$ is a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]: $\varphi$ is flat and for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset A$, with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], the fibre ring $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is Noetherian and geometrically regular over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Proposition Tag 07PM (proposition-fs-regular, line 12028), implication (4) => (1), and its proof (Proposition 07NQ fs-flat-fibre-fs; Algebra Lemma 032D complete-local-Noetherian-domain-finite-over-regular; Lemmas find-D, descent-fs, lift-derivation-through-fs, degree-p-extension-regular)

proof.text: *Flatness.* $\varphi$ is a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings and $B$ is formally smooth over $A$ for the $\mathfrak m_B$-adic topology, so $\varphi$ is flat and the closed fibre $B/\mathfrak m_AB$ is geometrically regular over $k=A/\mathfrak m_A$ [lem-weil-pbc-fs-adic-flat-geometrically-regular-closed-fibre]. It remains to show, for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset A$, that the fibre ring $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is Noetherian and geometrically regular over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]; fix $\mathfrak p$.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Proposition Tag 07PM (proposition-fs-regular, line 12028), first sentences: (4) => (2), (3) by Proposition 07NQ (fs-flat-fibre-fs)

proof.text: For a prime $p$, locality implies $pB\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$, so $B/pB$ is nonzero. By [lem-weil-pbc-complete-local-quotient], $A/p$ and $B/pB$ are complete Noetherian local rings; $A/p$ is a domain. Formal smoothness descends directly: restrict a lifting problem to $A\to B$, lift by formal smoothness, and note that the lift kills $pB$ since the target is an $A/p$-algebra. The induced quotient map is local because maximal ideals are images of the original maximal ideals. The field $\kappa(p)$ is a fraction field of $A/p$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-complete-local-generic-fiber] to obtain geometric regularity of $\kappa(p)\otimes_{A/p}(B/pB)$. The quotient-tensor isomorphism and cancellation of base change identify this with $\kappa(p)\otimes_A B$ as a $\kappa(p)$-algebra. Noetherianity transports along this isomorphism, and regularity after every finite purely inseparable extension transports along its tensor base change. Together with the flatness established above, this proves regularity of the original map.
